about_the_game:
FIGHT AND MAKE AWESOME COMBOS!

avoid repeating attacks to make combos and achieve cool effects!

EXPLORE AND FIND STRANGE WEAPONS!

This little angel can use Spears, swords, and even familiars and firearms , each one with unique effects!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains nudity and mutilated characters, both displayed in pixelated form.
